title: Song asks with a real card: Review lyrics / Just do it act on click, no agent turn
description: Fabio 2026-10-01 (MPI-1002 look): the Review lyrics / Just do it options are text replies, so each click costs an agent turn, and the ask only happens if Cosmo follows his guide (it failed once). Make it a confirm card like spend/batch/install: Cosmo sends generate for Song, the app shows the lyrics box with the two buttons, a click opens or runs at once. Brief: brief.md. Umbrella MPI-1000.
